Dear Candidate,

Thank you for taking the time to speak with our clinical talent team regarding the Staff Nurse role at Apex Health Systems.

We enjoyed learning about your clinical background and would like to invite you for a technical round with our Nursing Superintendent. The interview has been scheduled for Thursday, 16th October at 11:00 AM IST via Google Meet.

Please note that Apex Health Systems does not charge any application, processing or registration fees at any stage of recruitment. All communications are sent strictly from @apexhealth.com email addresses.

You can review our company profile and current verified openings on our official careers portal:
https://example.com/careers

Best regards,
Rohan Verma
Senior Talent Acquisition Lead
Apex Health Systems
